shoulder_abd.source: ACE Lateral Raise: raise until the arms are level with the shoulders, about parallel with the floor

elbow_flex.source: ACE Lateral Raise: elbows extended or a slight bend; the lab draws 14 degrees (illustrative)

elbow_lead.source: ACE Lateral Raise: elbows and upper arms rise slightly ahead of the forearms; the lab draws 8 degrees (illustrative)

knee_flex.source: Lateral Raise Lab SPEC kneesSoftDeg 6 (illustrative); ACE: torso braced, no knee dip

shrug_cm.source: ACE Lateral Raise: shoulders held down and back throughout

wrist_pron.source: ACE Lateral Raise: neutral grip, front edge turned slightly up near shoulder level

torso_lean.source: ACE Lateral Raise: torso braced upright

muscles.peakSource: Dumbbell vs cable lateral raise study (PMC12277279): a dumbbell's load peaks at shoulder height, here the top hold (0.25 to 0.375 of the rep)

mistake.name: Dip, shrug and drop

tells.text: The knees dip to swing it up.
The shoulders shrug toward the ears.
Thumbs turn down at the top.

mistake.source: EMG study 2020 (PMC7503819): thumbs down raises upper-trap and rear-delt work; ACE: avoid shrugging
